resources.string: A PC-style keyboard for code and terminals on the Galaxy Z Fold7 inner screen, with Korean 2-set (dubeolsik) input.
2. Select FoldKey as the input method
Key event monitor. It requests TYPE_NULL input like a terminal and prints what it receives.
Show Latin letters on Korean keys
Preview popup on tap (swipes always show a preview)
Swipe down on a key sends Ctrl+key
Apps treated as terminals (no composing text, Enter sends a key event). Comma separated package names:

• Swipe up: shifted character (9 → (, \' → \") • Swipe down: Ctrl+key (c → ^C); on the number row F1–F12 • Long press: same as swipe up, or repeat (setting) • Drag on space: left/right moves the cursor, up/down sends ↑ ↓ (with Shift: select) • Esc/Ctrl key: tap for Esc, hold with another key for Ctrl. Fn + Esc: Insert • Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Fn: tap once for the next key, double tap to lock, or hold while typing • Fn + digits: F1–F10, Fn + ⌫: Del, Fn + h j k l: arrows, Fn + y o: Home End, Fn + u i: PgDn PgUp • Fn + other keys: special characters (· … ‘ ’ 「 」 ₩ × ÷ …); swipe up with Fn for the second symbol. Labels change while Fn is on • Arrow keys: swipe up for Home/End/PgUp/PgDn, hold to repeat • The strip shows special keys you sent (Esc, ^C, Tab…)
Show copied text (tap to paste, kept in memory for 1 hour, sensitive clips skipped)
Show the text before the cursor (not in password fields)
Also show what you type in terminals (passwords typed at prompts become visible)

Hold the device with both hands. Keep each thumb comfortably stretched and draw one stroke through all five shaded keyboard rows. Three strokes per thumb.
